scope: New Sofia appointment grooming businesses only. Standalone owner sites first; merchant-authored public reservation menus when no standalone site is discoverable. No retail/daycare substitution, Google payloads, ratings, owner photos, geocoding, restricted/account data, booking submissions or production writes.
evidencePolicy: Actual appointment/reservation entry and exact included service menu first, then contact/location/weekly hours. Notino receipts cover public merchant reservation menus and controls, not unseen calendar steps or a live slot promise; Easybook receipts include fully opened selected service forms. No account/login or submission. Provider-host profile is explicitly identified, not misrepresented as a standalone owner domain. Public telephone is retained only where the merchant supplied it; otherwise null. Dynamic open-status and clinic-wide reception hours are not groomer weekly schedules. All stationary premises have owner/merchant-published street addresses and null coordinates. Blocked tariffs and missing appointment evidence remain pending, not not_publicly_listed.
